rules.description: A transcript message that is the fact-extractor system prompt itself (full template, message-anchored).
patterns: (?is)^you extract atomic facts from a text for a semantic memory system\.\s*rules:.*\{"facts": \["fact 1", "fact 2"\]\}.{0,200}$

patterns: (?i)^(the )?(response|reply|answer|output) (must|should) be (only|just) (a |an )?json object (in|with) the format \{"facts".{0,120}$
(?i)^(a )?(resposta|sa[ií]da) deve ser (apenas |somente )?um objeto json no formato \{"facts".{0,120}$
(?i)^(each|every) (atomic )?fact (must|should) be self-contained( and (reusable|reutiliz[aá]vel))?( in future searches)?\.?$

rules.description: A transcript message that is a session-continuation summary or a compaction request/caveat (full template, message-anchored).
patterns: (?is)^this session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context\.\s*the summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation\..*$
(?is)^your task is to create a detailed summary of the conversation so far, paying close attention to.*$

(?is)^caveat: the messages below were generated by the user while running local commands\. do not respond to these messages or otherwise consider them in your response unless the user explicitly asks you to\.?.{0,600}$

rules.description: A fact that only restates that the session continues an earlier conversation, or that a compaction summary exists.
patterns: (?i)^(the |this |a )?(current )?session (is|was) (a )?continuation (of|from) (a |the )?(previous|earlier|prior) conversation( that (ran out of|exceeded)( the)? context( limit)?)?\.?$
(?i)^(the |this )?(current )?session (continues|continued|resumes) from (a |the )?(previous|earlier|prior) conversation( that .{0,40})?\.?$
(?i)^the user is continuing (a|the) session from (a|the) previous conversation( that ran out of context)?\.?$

(?i)^a sess[ãa]o( atual)? (continua|prossegue|retoma) (de )?uma conversa anterior.{0,60}$
(?i)^the summary( below)? covers the (earlier|previous) (portion|part) of the conversation\.?$

(?i)^(the user )?(ran|executed|used) the [`'\"]?/compact[`'\"]? command.{0,80}$

rules.description: A transcript message that is a commit-message generator prompt (request to write a commit message from a diff, plus the diff).
patterns: (?is)^(write|generate|create|draft) (a|an|the) (\w+ ){0,3}commit message\b.{0,200}\b(from|based on|using|for) (a |an |the |this |these )?(staged )?(git )?diff\b.*$

rules.description: A fact that only describes a commit-message generator request or prompt, not a project's own commit conventions.
patterns: (?i)^(gere|escreva|crie|elabore|generate|write|create)\b.{0,60}\b(mensage(m|ns) de commit|commit messages?)\b.{0,160}\b(git diff|staged|stdin)\b.{0,300}$

(?i)^(o|este|esse|a|the|this) (texto|prompt|comando|entrada|text|command|input) (fornecido )?(é|e|descreve|cont[ée]m|solicita|pede|instrui|is|describes|contains|requests|asks) .{0,80}\b(mensage(m|ns) de commit|commit messages?)\b.{0,120}\b(git diff|staged|stdin)\b.{0,300}$

rules.description: A fact that is only diff arithmetic: binary file sizes in bytes, insertion/deletion counts. Review-only by default.
patterns: (?i)^.{0,200}\.(png|jpe?g|gif|webp|svg|ico|bmp)\b.{0,100}\d[\d.,]*\s*bytes\b.{0,400}$
(?i)^.{0,200}\b\d[\d.,]*\s+(insertions?|deletions?|inser[çc](ões|ão)|dele[çc](ões|ão)|exclus(ões|ão))\b.{0,150}$
(?i)^.{0,100}\b(passou de|went from) 0 (para|to) \d[\d.,]*\s*bytes\b.{0,40}$
